pattern.description: ast-grep pattern, e.g. foo($A, $$$REST); one node per $NAME, a list per $$$NAME.

rewrite.description: Replacement using the pattern's metavariables; omit to only search.

lang.description: Language of the files to match.

paths.description: Capsule-relative files or directories; default the whole capsule.

apply.description: true writes every replacement; false (default) previews them.

max_matches.description: Matches listed in the result (default 100); the total is always counted.
